Fixed: Pre-request and post-response script errors no longer show a raw, unhelpful engine stack trace (e.g. "at new AsyncFunction (<anonymous>)... at self.onmessage..."). Errors are now trimmed down to the message plus a clean trace through the user's own script functions, with correct line/column numbers and a "Pre-request script —" / "Post-response script —" prefix identifying which phase raised it.

The bundled skill.md now documents that pre_script and post_script are each allowed at most once per request section (independently of each other) — one of each is the normal shape. Previously undocumented, which could lead an AI agent to insert a second pre_script or post_script instead of adding more lines to the existing one.

Fixed Node.js/Python detection reporting "not found" on machines where they were genuinely installed. The detector previously only checked a short hardcoded list of common install paths (including a `~/.nvm/current` symlink that nvm does not actually create by default) against the minimal PATH Electron GUI apps inherit when launched from Finder/Dock/Taskbar — invisible to anything installed via nvm, asdf, mise, pyenv, or a non-default location. Detection now first resolves the PATH exactly as the user's own login shell would see it (sourcing .zshrc/.bash_profile/nvm.sh, etc.), falls back to correctly reading nvm's actual on-disk layout, and finally the existing hardcoded paths. Also fixed Python's detector silently having no PATH fallback at all (unlike Node's), and scripts now run with the same resolved PATH rather than a narrower hardcoded one.

Added: The Pre-Request Script and Post-Response Script blocks now show an inline "?" help tooltip in their header, matching the other request blocks
An "Open Documentation" item now appears in the right-click block menu for Pre-Request Script and Post-Response Script blocks, opening the Voiden Blocks docs in your system browser

Improved: AI skill documentation updated with accurate scripting API reference for JavaScript and Python, including cookies access, correct read-only labels, and !== operator

Added: voiden.response.body is now auto-parsed for JSON responses — access keys directly (e.g. voiden.response.body.userId) in JavaScript and Python without manual JSON.parse()
Fixed: Shell scripts continue to receive response body as a raw JSON string (use jq for key extraction)
Remove catch-all shim from build pipeline for correct dependency bundling
Skill documentation rewritten with accurate API reference for JavaScript, Python, and Shell

Added: Python script execution via post-response hooks
Access to response status, headers, and body
